First-party fixtures are generated by `generate_tiff_fixtures.py` and the independent byte writer in
`tests/cli/tiff_fixtures.py`, without libtiff or an image library. The 19x17 sample matrix is:
8-bit `(19*x + 37*y + 53*channel) % 256`; 16-bit
`(1493*x + 2039*y + 8191*channel + 1) % 65536`. Layouts cross both file endian orders,
classic/BigTIFF, separate/contiguous and strips/tiles, including partial final strips and edge tiles.
Literal LZW resets before a code-width transition; Deflate uses Python's independent zlib binding.
PackBits is literal framing. CCITT Group 3/4 fixtures independently code alternating all-white/
all-black 16-pixel rows (MSB stored MINISWHITE samples 0/1). JPEG striles embed the adjacent
first-party independent JPEG writer's coefficients; expected decoded samples and tolerances follow
its README, rather than an uncompressed pre-encoding image promise.
